title: Thrill Combo 2.4
description_html:
Combo Activity :

( Reverse Bungee+ Giant Swing +SCAD Jump ) 

Combo Activity Includes:

  • Reverse Bungee in Rishikesh (180 ft) 
  • Giant Swing in Rishikesh (140 ft)
  • Scad Jump in Rishikesh (150 ft)

Experience the Thrill of Reverse Bungee Jumping in Rishikesh Reverse bungee jumping in Rishikesh offers a heart-racing adventure that will leave you exhilarated and craving for more. At Thrill Factory, you'll have the opportunity to engage in this unique and thrilling activity that takes bungee jumping to new heights. Prepare yourself for an adrenaline-fueled experience as you are catapulted into the sky with incredible force. The anticipation builds as you reach the pinnacle of the jump, and then the sudden release sends you soaring through the air, defying gravity. Reverse bungee jumping provides an extraordinary sensation of weightlessness and an unparalleled rush of excitement.

Giant Swing in Rishikesh offers an adrenaline-pumping adventure that will take your breath away. At Thrill Factory, you'll have the opportunity to embark on a thrilling ride that combines the exhilaration of a swing with the excitement of freefall. Prepare yourself for a heart-pounding experience as you are lifted high above the ground and then released into an incredible pendulum swing. The rush of wind, the feeling of weightlessness, and the sheer speed make the giant swing an unforgettable adventure.

SCAD jumping in Rishikesh offers an adrenaline-pumping adventure that will push your limits and leave you with an unforgettable experience. At Thrill Factory, you'll have the chance to engage in SCAD jumping, a unique and thrilling activity that will have you soaring through the air. Prepare yourself for an extraordinary leap from India's highest fixed platform, standing at an astounding height. As you prepare for the jump, your heart pounding with excitement, the breathtaking views of the surrounding natural beauty will further enhance the thrill. The incredible rush of adrenaline and the sensation of weightlessness during the descent make SCAD jumping a truly remarkable adventure.
